name: hypermemory
description: Persistent hypergraph memory for OpenClaw. Store and recall interconnected knowledge across conversations.
author: RunStack AI

tools.name: hypermemory_overview
tools.description: Get a high-level summary of the memory graph including statistics and top connected nodes. Call this at the start of every conversation.

tools.name: hypermemory_store
tools.description: Store a new memory node with optional relationships to other nodes. Use for facts, preferences, decisions, project details.

key.description: Unique identifier for the memory (e.g., user_name, preference_language, project_webapp_stack)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this memory represents

nodes.description: Array of node keys involved in this relationship (2 or more)

relationship.description: Type of relationship (e.g., relates_to, part_of, depends_on, owned_by)

tools.name: hypermemory_recall
tools.description: Search memory for information related to a query. Returns matching nodes and their relationships.

max_results.description: Maximum number of nodes to return (default: 10)

max_depth.description: How many relationship hops to traverse (default: 2)

tools.name: hypermemory_update
tools.description: Update an existing memory node. Use when information changes rather than creating duplicates.

key.description: Key of the node to update

tools.name: hypermemory_forget
tools.description: Remove a memory from the graph. Use for outdated or incorrect information.

key.description: Key of the node to delete

cascade.description: If true, also removes edges connected to this node (default: true)

tools.name: hypermemory_find_related
tools.description: Find nodes related to a specific memory through relationship traversal.

key.description: Key of the node to find relations for

tools.name: hypermemory_add_relationships
tools.description: Add relationships between existing nodes without modifying the nodes themselves.

nodes.description: Node keys involved (2 or more for hyperedges)
